messages.content: You maintain a careful internal record for the Library Network. Preserve stated rules, distinguish verified evidence from commentary, and do not invent missing facts. A later handoff may summarize shared background, so the record must remain coherent even when an earlier decision is no longer quoted. Treat classification labels as exact ledger entries, not as suggestions or prose. Keep unrelated operational threads separate from the focal decision. The standing receipt mark is Pewter; this direct fact is unrelated to the earlier classification record.

We are reconciling the transfer docket at the river branch. The focal entry concerns one traveling collection, and the circulation planner has asked us to apply a deterministic rule. Record Comet only if every required tag is present and no forbidden tag is present; otherwise record Violet. Required tags are calm, dry, verified; forbidden tags are restricted, quarantined. Read the mapping literally and retain the exact capitalization of the two possible ledger words. The first unrelated thread concerns book-cart wheel service: its count was copied from yesterday and will be checked separately. That inventory neither changes a predicate nor selects a classification label.

I have separated the classification rule from the book-cart wheel service thread. The latter still needs a physical recount before anyone closes its worksheet, but it supplies no input to the focal rule. A second unrelated thread concerns evening key census. Its appointment was moved to the following week, and the move affects staff availability only. I will preserve both threads as context without using either one as evidence for the focal answer. The operations margin also records who will perform each follow-up and which worksheet will receive the confirmation. Those notes make the conversation realistically interleaved, yet they do not add a criterion, change a comparison, or create an exception.

Here is the one revised focal input supplied by the circulation planner. The final observed tag on the traveling collection is verified. All other focal records and both unrelated threads remain as already stated. Use the revised input for the ledger decision, but do not treat the act of revision itself as an extra priority, tag, score, interval, capacity item, or alias edge.

The revised input is now attached to the focal worksheet. I am leaving the book-cart wheel service recount open and keeping the evening key census appointment in its own operations section. Neither thread changes the decision rule, the fixed records, or the label mapping. The audit trail distinguishes the submitted evidence from the calculation that follows, so a reviewer can reconstruct the result without relying on tone or order. The worksheet has separate boxes for source evidence, the deterministic transformation, and the final ledger entry. Only the source-evidence box receives the revision; the rule box stays fixed. This separation prevents an incidental scheduling remark from masquerading as focal data.

Before this portion of the discussion is compacted, make a final decision record. Confirm that the focal rule was applied only to its declared evidence. Also note that the first unrelated chain, book-cart wheel service, remains pending a recount, while the second, evening key census, has only a later appointment. Close both distractor chains explicitly as irrelevant. Do not turn either operational detail into a hidden exception.

Final evicted decision record: observed tags calm, dry, verified. The pure rule therefore yields the exact focal ledger word Comet. The book-cart wheel service recount and the evening key census appointment are closed here as unrelated operational chains; neither was consulted in deriving the label. This entry names the outcome explicitly and preserves the evidence-to-rule path for review before the boundary.

We are now past the decision-record boundary. Continue with a neutral handoff check that does not restate, imply, revise, or challenge the earlier focal rule, its inputs, or its result. The remaining exchange concerns only direct administrative facts that stay visible after compaction.  Please acknowledge the direct fact and the separation of topics without summarizing any earlier option, number, condition, branch, referent, or label. This request intentionally leaves the prior decision opaque. It asks for no calculation and offers no substitute evidence; it only establishes what remains safe to discuss in the visible administrative tail.

It is a direct administrative acknowledgement only.
